title: Cartwise+ Plan Standing and the Wrong-Item Keep Share (Member Benefit Note)
content:
**Member benefit note for Cartwise Grocery Orders.** On a wrong-item refund — where the customer keeps a product that differs from the replacement they approved — the wrong-item keep share follows the standing of the Cartwise+ Membership recorded on the order.

## The rule

The wrong-item keep share depends on the Cartwise+ membership recorded on the order:

- when that membership is on a **monthly plan** and the customer's membership ledger shows **at least 6 period fees** charged within the last **6 whole calendar months**, the share is **60 percent**;
- when that membership is on an **annual plan** and the ledger shows **at least 1 period fee** charged within the last **12 whole calendar months**, the share is **75 percent**;
- membership standing that meets neither description does not alter the wrong-item keep share (including an order with no membership recorded).

## Counting months

Months are counted by anniversary: between an earlier date and a later date as many whole months have passed as there are monthly anniversaries of the earlier date falling on or before the later date, so a period fee counts as charged within the last N whole calendar months when fewer than N such months have passed from its charge date to today, and a fee charged earlier in the current month is 0 months old.

## Tier table

| Plan billing cycle of the membership on the order | Period fees in the Cartwise+ Membership ledger | Keep share |
|---|---|---|
| Monthly | 6 or more within the last 6 whole months | 60 percent |
| Monthly | 5 or fewer within the last 6 whole months | not altered by this note |
| Annual | 1 or more within the last 12 whole months | 75 percent |
| Annual | none within the last 12 whole months | not altered by this note |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

- A period fee charged on 15 March, looked at on 14 September: the anniversaries 15 April, 15 May, 15 June, 15 July and 15 August fall on or before 14 September — 5 whole months, fewer than 6, so the fee counts within the last 6 whole months.
- The same fee looked at on 15 September: a sixth anniversary falls on that day — 6 whole months, not fewer than 6, so the fee no longer counts.
- A monthly member whose ledger shows exactly 6 counted period fees meets "at least 6" and takes 60 percent; one with 5 does not.
